records.subject: Commemoration of the Baptism of the Lord

image.licence: Object page explicitly public domain; NGA Open Access unrestricted commercial/noncommercial use

records.assessment: NGA curatorial description identifies the baptismal scene specifically with Matthew 3:17 (voice from heaven), whereas the feast proper cited in the queue is John 1:29–34. Exact baptism subject but not a literal depiction of all verses in John 1. Distinct from the five existing Met/Cleveland Baptism candidates; no score assigned.
